segments.name: Asset management
segments.description: Provides investment management and related services, including fund administration, distribution and shareholder services, to individual and institutional clients.
segments.evidence: The Company operates in one business segment, namely as an asset manager providing investment management and related services for individual and institutional clients.

revenueModel.text: The company earns asset-based fees from funds and clients, calculated as a percentage of average net assets of the investment portfolios managed, plus distribution, administration and shareholder service fees.
revenueModel.evidence: Investment management fees, distribution and service fees, and administration and shareholder service fees are generally calculated as a percentage of average net assets of the investment portfolios managed.
